evidence.quote: multiple clans of a Dwarf realm engage in the same craft
evidence.claim: Craft associations provide the cultural context for craft emblems. The generated label neither creates a guild nor determines its profession, membership, regulation or recognition.

evidence.quote: Most Dwarf words have several meanings.
evidence.claim: The selected senses are explicit. New concatenated symbolic labels are adaptations, not attested complete names or a complete guildhall naming grammar. The same section identifies the Runescribe craftguild, grounding the record motif without assigning that profession.
A guildhall is explicitly attested as a Dwarf institution. Its associated shrine is particular to that source, and is not assigned to generated DF guildhalls.

evidence.quote: All guilds follow the path of apprentice, journeyman and master
evidence.claim: Craft institutions are also attested in 8th Edition. No generated label grants one of these ranks or the source guilds' authority; 4e remains the primary source for the craft-guild context.

Inscribed hard materials and the adjacent description of beaten-metal books support material-record emblems. These labels create no actual record, historical content or sacred text; ornamental gold and the specific oak wood are selected glossary senses.

The account of peacetime craft supports architectural imagery alongside tools and worked materials. It does not prescribe guildhall names or establish the generated hall's construction, dimensions, quality or physical features.
Silver and bread are attested independent concepts, not invented product or wealth claims.
The glossary distinguishes a musical horn from horn material, and attests road and thunder. Selected nouns remain literal word senses inside adapted labels.
The selected moonlight sense and the printed material, shadow, work and sunrise nouns add distinct concepts. No generic machine, dawn-direction, geology or ancestry meaning is invented.

The conjunction explicitly pairs two reviewed images. Thrag means wound, Thrynaz includes laws, Tiwaz includes rest and Skaud includes song. These are not new translations for hospital, government or tavern.

High-resolution printed text confirms Zunthrum with n. Spear, money, sunset, remembering and gift are independently attested; none assigns actual stock, wealth, a historical event or a commemorated person.
